{"action":"done","summary":"All 227 tests pass (223 upstream + 4 acceptance_public). The existing tinydb/journal.py BatchWriter implementation satisfies all requirements R01-R08:

- R01: apply(operations) accepts insert/remove operation dicts, returns inserted IDs, raises ValueError on malformed ops
- R02: Atomic batch application with full rollback on error (deepcopy snapshot validated before committing)
- R03: Ordinary TinyDB reads/writes work; deepcopies prevent aliasing
- R04: bool rejected as doc_id (isinstance check with not isinstance(x, bool)), structural validation, empty dicts accepted
- R05: preview() returns IDs without committing or consuming IDs
- R06: No stale snapshot - reads directly from db.storage.read() each time
- R07: Idempotency token support with repeat detection and ValueError on conflict
- R08: Tokens stored only in BatchWriter instance, never in documents; deepcopies prevent internal leakage

No changes were needed to the source code - the existing implementation already meets all requirements."}
